Ask questions, write, code, brainstorm and learn. No account, no key, no install. Powered by free public models. Please use responsibly — illegal or harmful requests are blocked.

How it works

1. Type below and press Send. 2. The browser calls the free text API with your prompt. 3. If the network is blocked, the built-in offline demo replies instantly so you can still try the UI. 4. Use Clear to erase local history.
